item.title: Early voting locations for Lubbock County March 2026 election
item.description: Early voting for the March primaries in Lubbock County, Texas begins on February 17, 2026, with 22 locations available for voters to cast their ballot.

item.title: Know your ballot: Railroad Commissioner
item.description: The Railroad Commission of Texas is responsible for regulating the state's oil and natural gas industry, and the election of a new commissioner is important for the economic vitality of the state.

item.title: Plainview officials provide update after wildfire
item.description: Multiple fire crews responded to a wildfire that occurred on Feb. 17.

item.title: East Lubbock Art House to teach art classes to inmates at the Lubbock County Detention Center
item.description: The East Lubbock Art House is creating a new program for inmates at the Lubbock County Detention Center to teach them how to use art as a tool for healing and growth.

item.title: Lucille Graves: Trailblazer at Texas Tech University
item.description: Lucille S. Graves was the first black student to attend Texas Tech University, and her persistence paved the way for more than a dozen black students to enroll the following fall semester.

item.title: Federal lawsuit: Lubbock, Amarillo Red Roof Inn motels ignored signs of sex trafficking
item.description: A sex trafficking survivor filed a lawsuit against the Lubbock and Amarillo Red Roof Inn and its owners, alleging they knowingly benefited from sex trafficking on their hotel premises.
